notes.title: Update: Japanese translation added, and a few minor improvements
notes.content:
- Japanese translation added
- Custom court ceiling color changed
- Gamepad infinite vibration fixed

notes.title: Black screen hotfix
notes.content: Some players reporting encountering with a black screen at the beginning of the game tried to be solved. We are not sure if this patch will solve all the black screen cases, but it aims to be a fast start.
